name: Hamsa
tagline: A sculptural wall cabinet shaped around the poetry of the Hamsa.
story: Hamsa takes its name from the graceful bird that has travelled through Indian art, architecture, textiles, and visual storytelling for centuries. At the centre of the composition, a hand-painted Hamsa unfolds through sweeping plumage and intricate floral linework, becoming the visual heart of an architectural wall-mounted form.
